summary: A proposed 3-story-plus-basement lab/office building at 700 Indiana St in Dogpatch, replacing an existing one-story building, for tenant MBC BioLabs. SF Planning Commission approved the project in June 2024; a neighborhood appeal of its CEQA exemption was rejected by the Board of Supervisors in September 2024, clearing it to proceed. No building permit had been issued as of September 2026.

milestones.text: SF Planning Commission approves the project (Case No. 2023-001074ENX, Motion No. 21576).

SF Board of Supervisors approves Motion No. M24-089 (File No. 240778) 9-1, affirming the Planning Department's CEQA general plan evaluation exemption and rejecting a neighborhood appeal (Appeal No. 24-040); Supervisor Walton (District 10) cast the dissenting vote and Supervisor Peskin was excused. The Board's minutes of September 24, 2024 also record an earlier 8-2 vote on the same file: Supervisor Walton's motion to table M24-089 failed, 2 ayes (Ronen, Walton) to 8 noes.

open_questions: Two different named appeal bodies appear in sources on this project: the Board of Supervisors (which heard and rejected the CEQA exemption appeal, resolved 2024-09-24, the event recorded above) and a separate Board of Appeals item (Appeal No. 24-040, continued to a Nov 13, 2024 hearing) whose subject and outcome could not be confirmed -- not established here whether it is the same matter under a different docket or a genuinely separate appeal.
